ayuda.pc_ayuda_titulo: Centre request: what it does and does not do
ayuda.pc_ayuda_certificado_titulo: Does signing in with a certificate sign a document?
ayuda.pc_ayuda_certificado: No. The certificate only identifies you when you sign in. Submitting or ratifying a request does not electronically sign a document.
ayuda.pc_ayuda_registro: The request and its ratification are recorded with the author, date and receipt. Electronic signing is not yet available; it will be added when the corporate signing process is defined.
ayuda.pc_ayuda_despues: Once ratified, the request appears in the Human Resources worklist. HR reviews the details and, if appropriate, creates the temporary staffing case. The centre does not need to send it again.

incorporaciones.ayuda: After HR appoints or contracts the person, the centre confirms the day they joined with the required document: the assumption-of-duty document for appointments or the signed contract for employment contracts, as specified by the catalogue. Enter the document reference (from Documents or the centre’s register) and choose the file. Its fingerprint is calculated on this device and only that fingerprint is recorded; the document is neither sent nor stored in VEC. If HR has not yet made the appointment, the case shows “Not yet applicable”.

cancelaciones.ayuda_titulo: When may the centre cancel a case?
cancelaciones.ayuda: Before HR completes financial review, the centre may cancel the case if the staffing need has ended or for another reason in the catalogue. Only cases from this centre’s requests at a stage that permits cancellation appear here. Choose a reason and add a comment if needed. The cancelled case keeps its full history, and HR can see who cancelled it and why.
